   "source": [
    "# Two fleets in the Baltic\n",
    "\n",
    "[Regional networks](https://zerocarbonshipping.github.io/navigate-zcs/workshop-preview/examples/regional-networks.html) · deck `simulations/examples/example_3/`\n",
    "\n",
    "How much do the owners' efficiency choices matter on the same trade?\n",
    "\n",
    "## The case"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "73695809",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "![Map of the Baltic case: mid-range tankers between Helsinki, Stockholm and Gdansk, coastal tankers between Helsinki, Tallinn and Stockholm, and a European e-ammonia plant delivering to Helsinki and Stockholm](data:image/png;base64,)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "bde2754b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "- **Ships:** product tankers in the Baltic, in two fleets that are the same in\n",
    "  everything but one choice. The *regular* owners fit no efficiency measure; the\n",
    "  *efficient* owners can fit eight (air lubrication, rotor sails, hull paint,\n",
    "  propeller devices and others). Each fleet starts with 2 MR tankers\n",
    "  (~47,000 DWT) and 3 coastal tankers (~7,500 DWT): a handful of ships, not a\n",
    "  market segment.\n",
    "- **Routes:** the MR tankers sail Helsinki, Stockholm and Gdansk; the coastal\n",
    "  tankers Helsinki, Tallinn and Stockholm. Trade grows 5 % a year.\n",
    "- **Fuels:** fuel oil everywhere; e-ammonia from a European plant, bunkered at\n",
    "  Helsinki and Stockholm only.\n",
    "- **Policy:** EU ETS and FuelEU on every port, CII, and a net-zero framework\n",
    "  whose values are the deck's own, not the data library's.\n",
    "- **Horizon:** 2026 to 2050, yearly.\n",
    "\n",
    "## Results"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "38193532",
   "metadata": {
    "cellView": "form",
    "jupyter": {
     "source_hidden": true
    },
    "tags": [
     "remove-cell"
    ]
   },
   "outputs": [

     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [

      "Navigate 1.0.0 is already installed.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# @title Setup\n",
    "# Setup. Works both on Google Colab and in a local checkout of the repository.\n",
    "import os\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# The branch these notebooks live on, and the one Colab clones. The \"Open in\n",
    "# Colab\" badge at the top of the notebook, like the links between the\n",
    "# notebooks, opens the copy on the workshop-colab branch instead: the same\n",
    "# notebooks with their outputs cleared, rebuilt from this branch by\n",
    "# .github/workflows/workshop-colab.yml. Change BRANCH, and that workflow, to\n",
    "# \"main\" once the branch has been merged.\n",
    "BRANCH = \"dev-workshop\"\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def at_repo_root() -> bool:\n",
    "    \"\"\"True if the working directory is the root of the repository.\"\"\"\n",
    "    return Path(\"navigate\").is_dir() and Path(\"assumptions\").is_dir()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "if at_repo_root():\n",
    "    print(\"Already at the repository root.\")\n",
    "elif Path(\"../../navigate\").is_dir():\n",
    "    # Local Jupyter starts the kernel in the notebook's own folder,\n",
    "    # docs/workshop/, but the paths below are relative to the repository root.\n",
    "    os.chdir(\"../..\")\n",
    "    print(\"Moved up to the repository root.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    # Colab, or any other fresh environment\n",
    "    if not Path(\"navigate-zcs\").is_dir():\n",
    "        !git clone --depth 1 -b {BRANCH} https://github.com/zerocarbonshipping/navigate-zcs.git\n",
    "    os.chdir(\"navigate-zcs\")\n",
    "    print(\"Cloned the repository and moved into it.\")\n",
    "\n",
    "assert at_repo_root(), f\"not at the repository root: {Path.cwd()}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "# `import navigate` is not a usable test here: from the repository root it\n",
    "# succeeds because the source folder is present, even when the `navigate`\n",
    "# command itself is missing.\n",
    "import sys\n",
    "from importlib.metadata import PackageNotFoundError, version\n",
    "\n",
    "try:\n",
    "    print(f\"Navigate {version('navigate-zcs')} is already installed.\")\n",
    "except PackageNotFoundError:\n",
    "    %pip install -q .\n",
    "    print(\"Installed Navigate.\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# The example deck.\n",
    "EXAMPLE = Path(\"simulations/examples/example_3\")\n",
    "assert EXAMPLE.is_dir(), (\n",
    "    f\"{EXAMPLE} not found under {Path.cwd()}. On Colab the setup cell clones the \"\n",
    "    f\"{BRANCH!r} branch, so this deck has to be committed and pushed there.\"\n",
    ")\n"
   ]
  },

   ]
  },
  {

   "id": "c4007bcc",
   "metadata": {

    "jupyter": {

    },

    ]
   },
   "outputs": [

     "text": [
      "No technology cost of capital supplied for Fleet(\"mid_range_efficient\"), using vessel cost of capital. This will likely lead to a higher uptake of technologies.\n",
      "No technology cost of capital supplied for Fleet(\"coastal_efficient\"), using vessel cost of capital. This will likely lead to a higher uptake of technologies.\n"
     ]
    },
    {

       "<Figure size 1100x820 with 3 Axes>"
      ]
     },

     "data": {

   "source": [
    "# @title Run the case and see the results\n",
    "import sys\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "# The workshop's figure and the functions that fill it, shared with the\n",
    "# Examples pages: docs/workshop/_results.py.\n",
    "sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(\"docs/workshop\").resolve()))\n",
    "from _results import compare_with_previous, plot_cases, plot_fleet_emissions, print_summary, run_case, scale, summarise\n",
    "from _solver import guard_interior_point\n",
    "\n",
    "guard_interior_point()\n",
    "\n",
    "NAV = Path(\"simulations/examples/example_3/example_3.nav\")\n",
    "REF_TWEAK = None\n",
    "_m = run_case(NAV)\n",
    "ref = summarise(_m)\n",
    "plot_cases({\"reference\": ref}, annotate=True)\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "plot_fleet_emissions(_m, {\n",
    "    \"MR tankers (~47,000 DWT)\": {\"regular\": \"mid_range_regular\",\n",
    "                                 \"efficient\": \"mid_range_efficient\"},\n",
    "    \"Coastal tankers (~7,500 DWT)\": {\"regular\": \"coastal_regular\",\n",
    "                                     \"efficient\": \"coastal_efficient\"},\n",
    "}, {\"regular\": \"#4c4c4c\", \"efficient\": \"#377070\"})\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ===========================================================================\n",
    "#  The machinery for the sensitivity analysis. Nothing to edit here: the\n",
    "#  levers are further down.\n",
    "# ===========================================================================\n",
    "# each lever, and the forecasts it multiplies\n",
    "LEVERS = {\n",
    "    \"OIL_PRICE\": ['fossil_fuel_oil_price_global'],\n",
    "    \"EU_ETS_PRICE\": ['eu_ets_carbon_credit_price'],\n",
    "    \"EUROPE_ELECTRICITY_PRICE\": ['electricity_cost_europe_mid'],\n",
    "}\n",
    "_RUNS = []      # the scenarios solved so far, newest last: (levers, summary)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def run_your_scenario():\n",
    "    \"\"\"Solve the levers set in the YOUR SCENARIO cell and compare with\n",
    "    the reference and with the scenario solved before it.\"\"\"\n",
    "    changed = [(n, globals()[n]) for n in LEVERS if globals()[n] != 1.0]\n",
    "    if not changed:\n",
    "        print(\"Every lever is still at 1.0, so this would just re-solve the deck.\")\n",
    "        print(\"Change one of the numbers above and run this cell again.\")\n",
    "        return\n",
    "    tweaks = ([REF_TWEAK] if REF_TWEAK else []) + [scale(f, v) for n, v in changed\n",
    "                                                   for f in LEVERS[n]]\n",
    "\n",
    "    def your_scenario(m):\n",
    "        for t in tweaks:\n",
    "            t(m)\n",
    "\n",
    "    label = \",  \".join(f\"{n} x {v}\" for n, v in changed)\n",
    "    compare_with_previous(NAV, ref, your_scenario, label, _RUNS, ref_label=\"reference\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },

    "# ===========================================================================\n",
    "#  YOUR SCENARIO.  Set a lever, then run this cell: it solves your scenario\n",
    "#  and compares it with the reference and with the scenario you ran before it.\n",
    "#\n",
    "#  Every number is a MULTIPLIER on what the deck already says, so 1.0 is the\n",
    "#  deck. The right-hand column says what each 1.0 is worth, so you can judge\n",
    "#  whether a factor of two is a big change or a small one.\n",
    "#\n",
    "#  As an example, OIL_PRICE is set to 2.0: the fuel oil price doubled.\n",
    "#  Set OIL_PRICE back to 1.0 to start from the deck.\n",
    "#\n",
    "#                                   suggested span  what 1.0 means in the deck\n",
    "OIL_PRICE                = 2.0   #  0.7 - 2.0       485 USD/t, flat to 2050\n",
    "EU_ETS_PRICE             = 1.0   #  0.5 - 3.0       126 USD/t in 2026, 417 by 2050\n",
    "EUROPE_ELECTRICITY_PRICE = 1.0   #  0.6 - 1.4       72 USD/MWh in 2026, 53 by 2050: the power e-ammonia is made from\n",
    "# ===========================================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "run_your_scenario()\n"
   ]

font-weight: bold}.deck-e8a7d4f7 pre .kt {color: #5382a5}.deck-e8a7d4f7 pre .s {color: #c9753e}.deck-e8a7d4f7 pre .m {color: #457b7b}#deck-e8a7d4f7-0:checked ~ .p0 {display: block}#deck-e8a7d4f7-1:checked ~ .p1 {display: block}#deck-e8a7d4f7-2:checked ~ .p2 {display: block}#deck-e8a7d4f7-3:checked ~ .p3 {display: block}#deck-e8a7d4f7-4:checked ~ .p4 {display: block}#deck-e8a7d4f7-5:checked ~ .p5 {display: block}</style><div class=\"deck-e8a7d4f7\"><input type=\"radio\" name=\"deck-e8a7d4f7\" id=\"deck-e8a7d4f7-0\" checked><label for=\"deck-e8a7d4f7-0\">example_3.nav</label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"deck-e8a7d4f7\" id=\"deck-e8a7d4f7-1\"><label for=\"deck-e8a7d4f7-1\">Fleets</label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"deck-e8a7d4f7\" id=\"deck-e8a7d4f7-2\"><label for=\"deck-e8a7d4f7-2\">Route</label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"deck-e8a7d4f7\" id=\"deck-e8a7d4f7-3\"><label for=\"deck-e8a7d4f7-3\">Fuel</label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"deck-e8a7d4f7\" id=\"deck-e8a7d4f7-4\"><label for=\"deck-e8a7d4f7-4\">Regulation</label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"deck-e8a7d4f7\" id=\"deck-e8a7d4f7-5\"><label for=\"deck-e8a7d4f7-5\">Decisions</label><div class=\"p0\"><div class=\"cap\">example_3.nav</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SETTING THE SCENE – EXAMPLE 3 (BALTIC PRODUCT TANKERS WITH E-AMMONIA AND</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ENERGY EFFICIENCIES)</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># This example is based in Helsinki and is modeled through two operators with</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># similar fleets. Each operates a mix of MR tankers (~47k DWT) and coastal</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># tankers (~7.5k DWT) trading across the Baltic Sea, with regular voyages linking</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Helsinki, Stockholm, Tallinn, and Gdansk.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Both operators can use conventional fossil fuel or transition to</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># e-ammonia as an alternative. Fuel availability is assumed to be uneven:</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Helsinki and Stockholm provide both fossil fuels and e-ammonia, while Tallinn</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># and Gdansk supply fossil fuels only.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># The distinction lies in their adoption of energy-efficiency (EE) measures. One</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># operator (EE_fleet) implements a package of EE measures (such as hull and</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># propeller improvements, weather routing, and alternative power devices), while</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># the other (regular_fleet) does not. This setup allows for a direct comparison</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># of the economic and emissions impact of efficiency retrofits, under otherwise</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># identical conditions.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Operating within the European regulatory zone, the fleets are subject to both</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># IMO measures (CII and potential NZF) and EU regulations (FuelEU</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Maritime and the EU ETS). These frameworks create strong incentives for</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># reducing emissions through both fuel switching and efficiency improvements.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># This scenario provides a reference case for analyzing the combined and</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># comparative impacts of e-ammonia adoption and energy-efficiency measures on</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># short-sea tanker economics in the Baltic. Users can adjust fleet composition,</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># efficiency uptake, fuel costs, and regulatory assumptions in the .inc files to</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># test sensitivities and policy outcomes.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"k\">DEFINE</span> {\n",
       "\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># -------------------------- DEFINITIONS --------------------------</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># Import the default model settings. These provide baseline constants</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># and parameters that can be overwritten in this scenario.</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Load</span> DefaultModelDefinition\n",
       "\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># ---------------------------- FLEET ------------------------------</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># Defines the fleets of the two different operators, contaning multiple</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># tankers and similar vessel types, but differentiation on the EE-measures.</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/regular_fleet_curves.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/regular_fleet.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/efficient_fleet_curves.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/efficient_fleet.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># ----------------------------- ROUTE -----------------------------</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># Defines the ports included in the scenario (Helsinki, Stockholm, Tallinn, </span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># Gdansk) along with their characteristics. The route file specifies the </span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># distribution of voyages, port calls, and time allocation between sea </span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># and port conditions.</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/route.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/ports.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/bunker_logistics.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># ----------------------------- FUEL ------------------------------</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># Defines the fuels available in the scenario, their production processes,</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># feedstocks, costs, and emission factors. Regional differences and</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># plants are also defined here. </span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/fuel_production.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/regions.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/producer.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Load</span> DefaultEmission\n",
       "\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># -------------------------- REGULATION ---------------------------</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># Defines the relevant international regulatory frameworks affecting the</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># fleet. As we operate within EU, both IMO and EU jurisdiction are in </span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># effect. </span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/cii.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/eu_ets.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/fuel_eu.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/net_zero_framework.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># ---------------- DECISION PROCESESS ---------------------------</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Include</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;includes/decision_processes.inc&quot;</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># -------------------------- OUTPUT -----------------------------</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"k\">Load</span> DefaultPlot\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"k\">EVENTS</span> {\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># time-steps</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"k\">Load</span> DefaultTimeStepYearly\n",
       "}\n",
       "</pre></div><div class=\"p1\"><div class=\"cap\">includes/regular_fleet.inc</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ------------------------------ REGULAR FLEET --------------------------------</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># This file defines the baseline Baltic tanker fleet without any additional</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># energy-efficiency measures. The fleet includes both coastal tankers (~7,500</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># DWT) and MR tankers (~47,000 DWT), operating between Helsinki, Stockholm,</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Tallinn, and Gdansk. </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Vessels can be modeled on conventional fossil fuels or on e-ammonia,</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># allowing direct comparison of fuel transition costs and emissions. In this</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># baseline version, no efficiency upgrades are applied, providing a reference</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># case against which the EE fleet can be compared.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># -----------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Copy</span> <span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;tanker_47k_dwt_ice_oil&quot;</span>        <span class=\"s\">&quot;mid_range_regular_oil&quot;</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Copy</span> <span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;tanker_47k_dwt_ice_ammonia&quot;</span>    <span class=\"s\">&quot;mid_range_regular_ammonia&quot;</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Copy</span> <span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;tanker_7500_dwt_ice_oil&quot;</span>        <span class=\"s\">&quot;coastal_regular_oil&quot;</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Copy</span> <span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;tanker_7500_dwt_ice_ammonia&quot;</span>    <span class=\"s\">&quot;coastal_regular_ammonia&quot;</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Fleet</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;mid_range_regular&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\tVessels <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;mid_range_regular_oil&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;mid_range_regular_ammonia&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialVessels <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">2</span>\n",
       "\tInitialSplit <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"m\">0.5</span>, <span class=\"m\">0.5</span><span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialAgeDistribution <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"kt\">Curve</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;age_dist_mid_range_regular_oil&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>,\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"kt\">Curve</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;age_dist_mid_range_regular_ammonia&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># Trade growth: annual growth rate of 5%, but can be changed if expected otherwise or disabled to keep constant. </span>\n",
       "\tTradeGrowth <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">0.05</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># disallow the approximation of technology uptake from other fleets</span>\n",
       "\tAllowTechnologyApproximation <span class=\"o\">=</span> FALSE\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Fleet</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;coastal_regular&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\tVessels <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;coastal_regular_oil&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;coastal_regular_ammonia&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialVessels <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">3</span>\n",
       "\tInitialSplit <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"m\">1.0</span>, <span class=\"m\">0.0</span><span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialAgeDistribution <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"kt\">Curve</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;age_dist_coastal_regular_oil&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>,\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># Trade growth: annual growth rate of 5%, but can be changed if expected otherwise or disabled to keep constant.</span>\n",
       "\tTradeGrowth <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">0.05</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># disallow the approximation of technology uptake from other fleets</span>\n",
       "\tAllowTechnologyApproximation <span class=\"o\">=</span> FALSE\n",
       "}\n",
       "</pre><div class=\"cap\">includes/efficient_fleet.inc</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ------------------------------- EE FLEET ------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># This file defines the Baltic tanker fleet with energy-efficiency measures</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># enabled. As with the regular fleet, it includes both coastal tankers (~7,500</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># DWT) and MR tankers (~47,000 DWT), trading between Helsinki, Stockholm,</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Tallinn, and Gdansk.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Vessels can operate on fossil fuels or adopt e-ammonia, and have</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># similar specifications to those in the regular fleet. </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># This efficient fleet, however, get energy efficiency measures enabled from the</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># .inc file &quot;energy_efficiencies&quot;.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># -----------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Copy</span> <span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;tanker_47k_dwt_ice_oil&quot;</span>        <span class=\"s\">&quot;mid_range_efficient_oil&quot;</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Copy</span> <span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;tanker_47k_dwt_ice_ammonia&quot;</span>    <span class=\"s\">&quot;mid_range_efficient_ammonia&quot;</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Copy</span> <span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;tanker_7500_dwt_ice_oil&quot;</span>        <span class=\"s\">&quot;coastal_efficient_oil&quot;</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Copy</span> <span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;tanker_7500_dwt_ice_ammonia&quot;</span>    <span class=\"s\">&quot;coastal_efficient_ammonia&quot;</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Fleet</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;mid_range_efficient&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\tVessels <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;mid_range_efficient_oil&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;mid_range_efficient_ammonia&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialVessels <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">2</span>\n",
       "\tInitialSplit <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"m\">0.5</span>, <span class=\"m\">0.5</span><span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialAgeDistribution <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"kt\">Curve</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;age_dist_mid_range_efficient_oil&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>,\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"kt\">Curve</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;age_dist_mid_range_efficient_ammonia&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># Trade growth: annual growth rate of 5%, but can be changed if expected otherwise or disabled to keep constant. </span>\n",
       "\tTradeGrowth <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">0.05</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Fleet</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;coastal_efficient&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\tVessels <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;coastal_efficient_oil&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;coastal_efficient_ammonia&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialVessels <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">3</span>\n",
       "\tInitialSplit <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"m\">1.0</span>, <span class=\"m\">0.0</span><span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialAgeDistribution <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"kt\">Curve</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;age_dist_coastal_efficient_oil&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>,\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># Trade growth: annual growth rate of 5%, but can be changed if expected otherwise or disabled to keep constant.</span>\n",
       "\tTradeGrowth <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">0.05</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Fleet</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;*_efficient&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\tTechnologies <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span>\n",
       "\t\tTechnology<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;air_lubrication_tanker_35k_dwt&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>,\n",
       "\t\tTechnology<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;cargo_systems_tanker_35k_dwt&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>,\n",
       "\t\tTechnology<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;exhaust_gas_boiler_ae_tanker_35k_dwt&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>,\n",
       "\t\tTechnology<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;flettner_rotor_tanker_35k_dwt&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>,\n",
       "\t\tTechnology<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;hull_painting_tanker_35k_dwt&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>,\n",
       "\t\tTechnology<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;lighting_system_tanker_35k_dwt&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>,\n",
       "\t\tTechnology<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;propeller_improvement_devices_tanker_35k_dwt&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>,\n",
       "\t\tTechnology<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;variable_frequency_drive_tanker_35k_dwt&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "</pre><div class=\"cap\">includes/regular_fleet_curves.inc</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
