       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Curve</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;age_dist_mid_range_efficient_ammonia&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\t<span class=\"kt\">Table</span> <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\t<span class=\"m\">1</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">1</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">2</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">3</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">4</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">5</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">6</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">7</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">8</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">9</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">10</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">11</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">12</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">13</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">14</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">15</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">16</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">17</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">18</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">19</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">20</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">21</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">22</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">23</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">24</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Curve</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;age_dist_coastal_efficient_oil&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\t<span class=\"kt\">Table</span> <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">1</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">2</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">3</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">4</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">5</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">6</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.333</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">7</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">8</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">9</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.333</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">10</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">11</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">12</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">13</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">14</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.333</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">15</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">16</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">17</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">18</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">19</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">20</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">21</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">22</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">23</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"m\">24</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "</pre></div><div class=\"p2\"><div class=\"cap\">includes/route.inc</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ------------------------------ ROUTES ---------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># This file defines the transport routes used in the Baltic tanker scenario. </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Two separate route structures are included, reflecting the different roles </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># of the coastal tankers (~7.5k DWT) and the MR tankers (~47k DWT).</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># The coastal tankers operate primarily on short-sea trades linking Helsinki, </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Tallinn, and Stockholm. These vessels are suited to frequent, shorter legs </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># and to ports with more limited draft. Their operation emphasizes port time </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># and short sailing intervals.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># The MR tankers connect Helsinki and Stockholm with Gdansk. These vessels </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># handle larger parcels and cover longer legs across the Baltic, where they </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># spend a greater fraction of time at sea. MR tankers are also the first to </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># test the uptake of e-ammonia bunkering at major hubs.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Separating the coastal and MR routes makes it possible to capture differences </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># in operational profile, fuel consumption, and bunkering constraints while </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># keeping both fleets within the same regional trade network.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ----------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;mid_range_*&quot;</span> {\n",
       "    <span class=\"kt\">Route</span> <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Route</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;mid_range_route&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Vessel</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;coastal_*&quot;</span> {\n",
       "    <span class=\"kt\">Route</span> <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Route</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;coastal_route&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># MR loop: Helsinki - Stockholm - Gdansk</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Longer legs, larger vessels, more time at sea</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Route</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;mid_range_route&quot;</span> {\n",
       "    RouteType <span class=\"o\">=</span> REGIONAL_TRIP\n",
       "\n",
       "    Ports <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;helsinki&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;stockholm&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;gdansk&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)]</span>\n",
       "    PortCalls <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"m\">12</span>, <span class=\"m\">10</span>, <span class=\"m\">14</span><span class=\"o\">]</span> \n",
       " \n",
       "    TimeAtSea <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">0.55</span>\n",
       "    Speeds <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"m\">12.8</span>, <span class=\"m\">13.0</span>, <span class=\"m\">12.5</span><span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "    ConditionDistribution <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"m\">0.34</span>, <span class=\"m\">0.28</span>, <span class=\"m\">0.38</span><span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Coastal loop: Helsinki - Tallinn - Stockholm</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Short legs, frequent port calls, higher share of port time</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Route</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;coastal_route&quot;</span> {\n",
       "    RouteType <span class=\"o\">=</span> REGIONAL_TRIP\n",
       "\n",
       "    Ports <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;helsinki&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;tallinn&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;stockholm&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)]</span>\n",
       "    PortCalls <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"m\">14</span>, <span class=\"m\">12</span>, <span class=\"m\">10</span><span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "    TimeAtSea <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">0.40</span>\n",
       "    Speeds <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"m\">11.5</span>, <span class=\"m\">11.0</span>, <span class=\"m\">11.2</span><span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "    ConditionDistribution <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"m\">0.40</span>, <span class=\"m\">0.30</span>, <span class=\"m\">0.30</span><span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "</pre><div class=\"cap\">includes/ports.inc</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ---------------------------- PORTS --------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># This file defines the set of ports used in the Baltic tanker example:</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Helsinki, Stockholm, Tallinn, and Gdansk.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Helsinki serves as the operators&#39; base and a primary bunkering hub, where</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># both fossil fuels and e-ammonia are assumed to be available.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Stockholm is included as a secondary hub, also offering access to e-ammonia </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># alongside fossil fuels. </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Tallinn and Gdansk represent ports where bunkering infrastructure is assumed </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># to remain fossil-only, reflecting a slower uptake of e-ammonia outside the </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># main hubs. This creates the need for careful bunkering logistics when </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># operating across the network. </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Port definitions capture differences in fuel availability and handling costs.</span>\n",
       " <span class=\"c\"># These assumptions are important for modeling the transition</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># from fossil fuels to electro-fuels under combined IMO and EU regulatory </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># frameworks, and for illustrating the challenges faced by a regional tanker </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># operator in the Baltic.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Port</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;helsinki&quot;</span> {\n",
       "    set_bunkering_allowed<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_electro&quot;</span>, TRUE<span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Port</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;stockholm&quot;</span> {\n",
       "    set_bunkering_allowed<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_electro&quot;</span>, TRUE<span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Port</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;tallinn&quot;</span> {\n",
       "    set_bunkering_allowed<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_electro&quot;</span>, FALSE<span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Port</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;gdansk&quot;</span> {\n",
       "    set_bunkering_allowed<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_electro&quot;</span>, FALSE<span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Port</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span> {\n",
       "    set_bunkering_allowed<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span>, TRUE<span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># Here we overwrite to define the price and WTT of LSFO as we don&#39;t calculate it bottom up. </span>\n",
       "\tset_bunker_price_overwrite<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil_price_global&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_bunker_wtt_overwrite<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;carbon_dioxide&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil_wtt_carbon_dioxide&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\tset_handling_cost<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Variable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;handling_cost_oil&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "    set_handling_cost<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_electro&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Variable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;handling_cost_ammonia&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Here you can change the handling cost of oil and ammonia</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Variable</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;handling_cost_oil&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\tValue <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">8</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Variable</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;handling_cost_ammonia&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\tValue <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">25</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "</pre><div class=\"cap\">includes/bunker_logistics.inc</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ---------------------- BUNKER LOGISTICS -------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># This file defines the assumptions related to marine fuel supply and delivery </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># across the ports used in the scenario.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># In this case, fossil fuel oil is treated as a liquid market fuel —</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># widely available, with mature infrastructure and low delivery uncertainty.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ----------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">BunkerLogistics</span> {\n",
       "\tLiquidMarketFuels <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"kt\">Fuel</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\tset_distance<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span>, <span class=\"m\">1000</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\tset_transport_cost<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span>, <span class=\"m\">0.1</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "</pre></div><div class=\"p3\"><div class=\"cap\">includes/fuel_production.inc</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ------------------------------- FUEL PRODUCTION ---------------------------------</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># This file defines the fuels and production pathways available in the Baltic </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># tanker example. Conventional fuel oil is included as the fossil baseline, widely</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># available at all major ports in the region. Alongside this, the example</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># introduces electro-ammonia as a renewable alternative fuel.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Electro-ammonia is assumed to be produced in Europe, using renewable</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># electricity from the grid to power hydrogen electrolysis and nitrogen </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># separation. The hydrogen and nitrogen are then combined via a Haber-Bosch </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># process to synthesize ammonia. This reflects a likely future production </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># pathway for low-carbon fuels in Northern Europe, supported by the expansion </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># of wind and other renewable energy resources.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># By comparing fossil fuel with electro-ammonia, the example highlights both</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># the technical feasibility and the cost/emissions trade-offs of adopting an </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># electro-fuel in short-sea tanker operations in the Baltic.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Import</span> <span class=\"kt\">Fuel</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Electro-ammonia – renewable ammonia produced from hydrogen and nitrogen</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Import</span> <span class=\"kt\">Fuel</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_electro&quot;</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Production plant for electro-ammonia located in Europe</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Import</span> <span class=\"kt\">Plant</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;plant_ammonia_electro_alkaline&quot;</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Plant</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;plant_ammonia_electro_alkaline&quot;</span> {\n",
       "    <span class=\"kt\">Region</span> <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Region</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;europe&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"kt\">Source</span> <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Source</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;renewable&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>  <span class=\"c\"># stand-alone renewable electricity production</span>\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># as default_plant.inc sets it for an e-fuel plant in Europe; without it, 0 %</span>\n",
       "    CostOfCapital <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;cost_of_capital_plant_electro_europe&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Production processes for electro-ammonia (Haber-Bosch + supporting steps)</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Import</span> <span class=\"kt\">Process</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;electrolysis_stack_alkaline&quot;</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Import</span> <span class=\"kt\">Process</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_synthesis_electro_alkaline&quot;</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Import</span> <span class=\"kt\">Process</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;hydrogen_electro_alkaline&quot;</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Import</span> <span class=\"kt\">Process</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;nitrogen_air_separation&quot;</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Import</span> <span class=\"kt\">Feedstock</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;demineralized_water&quot;</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Electricity source definition</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Import</span> <span class=\"kt\">Source</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;renewable&quot;</span>\n",
       "</pre><div class=\"cap\">includes/regions.inc</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ------------------------------------ REGIONS ------------------------------------- </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># This file defines the geographic area of ammonia production, Europe. </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># The specific region plays a role in the upstream (WTT) part of the fuel supply chain, </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># affecting the overall cost and environmental impact of fuel production and delivery.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># These regional settings are used to calculate the lifecycle emissions and cost differences </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># for fuels, depending on where they are produced and consumed.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Region</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;europe&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># set feedstock cost</span>\n",
       "    set_feedstock_cost<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;demineralized_water&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;demineralized_water_cost&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># set energy source cost and emissions</span>\n",
       "    set_source_opex<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;renewable&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;electricity_cost_europe_mid&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># e-hydrogen (alkaline)</span>\n",
       "\tset_process_capex<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;electrolysis_stack_alkaline&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Timetable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;electrolysis_stack_alkaline_capex&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_process_opex<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;electrolysis_stack_alkaline&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Timetable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;electrolysis_stack_alkaline_opex&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_process_energy<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;electrolysis_stack_alkaline&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;electrolysis_stack_alkaline_energy&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_process_lifetime<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;electrolysis_stack_alkaline&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;electrolysis_stack_alkaline_lifetime&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_process_replacement<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;electrolysis_stack_alkaline&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;electrolysis_stack_alkaline_replacement&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\tset_process_capex<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;hydrogen_electro_alkaline&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Timetable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;hydrogen_electro_alkaline_capex&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_process_opex<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;hydrogen_electro_alkaline&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Timetable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;hydrogen_electro_alkaline_opex&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_process_energy<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;hydrogen_electro_alkaline&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;hydrogen_electro_alkaline_energy&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_process_lifetime<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;hydrogen_electro_alkaline&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;hydrogen_electro_alkaline_lifetime&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_process_replacement<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;hydrogen_electro_alkaline&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;hydrogen_electro_alkaline_replacement&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># e-ammonia</span>\n",
       "\tset_process_capex<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_synthesis_electro_*&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Timetable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_synthesis_capex&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_process_opex<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_synthesis_electro_*&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Timetable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_synthesis_opex&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_process_energy<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_synthesis_electro_*&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_synthesis_energy&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "</pre><div class=\"cap\">includes/producer.inc</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ------------------------------ PRODUCER ----------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># This block defines the e-ammonia producer entity responsible for fuel supply. It is located</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># in Europe. It links to a dedicated plant and is subject to regional capacity and development. </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Producer</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;epc_europe&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\tPlants <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"kt\">Plant</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;plant_ammonia_electro_alkaline&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># define existing production capacity</span>\n",
       "    InitialCapacity <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"m\">108</span><span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "    <span class=\"c\"># define the number of plants that can be built per year</span>\n",
       "\tMaximumDevelopment <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">1</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "</pre></div><div class=\"p4\"><div class=\"cap\">includes/cii.inc</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ------------------ CARBON INTENSITY INDICATOR ---------------------------</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Tracks compliance of international container ships with IMO’s CII rule </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># based on CO₂ per transport work (TTW). Used here for monitoring only, </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># with no effect on decision-making (remedial cost = 0).</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># -----------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Regulation</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;cii&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\n",
       "\tMeasure <span class=\"o\">=</span> TRANSPORT_NOMINAL\n",
       "\tScheme <span class=\"o\">=</span> INDIVIDUAL\n",
       "\n",
       "\tScope <span class=\"o\">=</span> TTW\n",
       "\tIncludeSlip <span class=\"o\">=</span> FALSE\n",
       "\n",
       "\tEmissions <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Emission</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;carbon_dioxide&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\tFuels <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Fuel</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\tJurisdiction <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;helsinki&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;stockholm&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;gdansk&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;tallinn&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)]</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># A remedial cost of zero means the regulation will have no influence on the decision making.</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># The CII regulation is purely included to track the compliance with the regulation in the output.</span>\n",
       "\tRemedialCost <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># CII applies to all vessels in this scenario</span>\n",
       "\tset_include_vessel<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span>, TRUE<span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># assign regulation specific emission factors according to MEPC308(73) for EEDI index</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_ttw<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;carbon_dioxide&quot;</span>, <span class=\"m\">3.114</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\t<span class=\"c\"># based on HFO</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_ttw<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_electro&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;carbon_dioxide&quot;</span>, <span class=\"m\">0.054</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\tset_vessel_threshold<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;coastal_*&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;cii_target_coastal&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_vessel_threshold<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;mid_range_*&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;cii_target_mid_range&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;cii_target_reduction&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\t<span class=\"kt\">Table</span> <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2019&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">1.0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2020&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.99</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2021&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.98</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2022&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.97</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2023&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.95</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2024&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.93</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2025&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.91</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2026&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.89</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2027&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.87</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2028&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.85</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2029&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.83</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2030&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.81</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\tExtrapolate <span class=\"o\">=</span> FLAT\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Copy</span> <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;cii_target_reduction&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;cii_target_coastal&quot;</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Copy</span> <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;cii_target_reduction&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;cii_target_mid_range&quot;</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;cii_target_coastal&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\tMultiplier <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">22.71</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;cii_target_mid_range&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\tMultiplier <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">7.41</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "</pre><div class=\"cap\">includes/eu_ets.inc</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># --------------------------------- EU ETS REGULATION -----------------------------------</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># This regulation models the EU Emissions Trading System (ETS) as applied to shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># in the Baltic region. It covers CO₂, CH₄, and N₂O emissions from vessels operating </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># within or entering Baltic ports.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Voyages inside the Baltic Sea are fully covered, with emissions priced via forecasted </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># carbon credit values.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># fossil fuel oil is treated as a conventional fossil marine fuel</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># with full emissions liability under ETS.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># E-ammonia (electro-ammonia) is assumed to be zero-rated for CO₂, since it </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># contains no carbon, but indirect N₂O emissions are included and priced using </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># conservative emission factors.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Regulation</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_ets&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\n",
       "\tMeasure <span class=\"o\">=</span> ABSOLUTE\n",
       "\tScheme <span class=\"o\">=</span> INDIVIDUAL\n",
       "\n",
       "\tScope <span class=\"o\">=</span> TTW\n",
       "\tIncludeSlip <span class=\"o\">=</span> FALSE <span class=\"c\"># accounted for through TTW methane emission factors</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\tEmissions <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"kt\">Emission</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;carbon_dioxide&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Emission</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;methane&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Emission</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;nitrous_oxide&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)]</span>\n",
       "\tFuels <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Fuel</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\tIntraFraction <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">1</span>\n",
       "\tInterFraction <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">0.5</span>\n",
       "\tExtraFraction <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\tJurisdiction <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;helsinki&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;stockholm&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;gdansk&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;tallinn&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)]</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\tRemedialCost <span class=\"o\">=</span> &lt;<span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_ets_carbon_credit_price&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span> * <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_ets_maritime_phase_in&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>&gt;\n",
       "\tset_vessel_threshold<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span>, <span class=\"m\">0</span>.<span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># EU ETS applies to both domestic and international vessels that enter or operate in the EU</span>\n",
       "\tset_include_vessel<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span>, TRUE<span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># Global warming potentials</span>\n",
       "\tset_global_warming_potential<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;carbon_dioxide&quot;</span>, <span class=\"m\">1</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\tset_global_warming_potential<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;methane&quot;</span>, <span class=\"m\">28</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\tset_global_warming_potential<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;nitrous_oxide&quot;</span>, <span class=\"m\">265</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># DEFAULT EMISSION FACTORS</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># EU ETS emission factors are based on MRV Maritime Regulation Annex I.</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># All bio and electro fuels are assumed to have a proven &gt;65% reduction relative to LSFO and thus meet the</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># criteria for &quot;zero-rated&quot; which means the fuel is classified with zero carbon dioxide emissions.</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># Blue ammmonia is assumed to have a proven &gt;70% reduction and thus be classed as a &quot;low-carbon fuel&quot; which</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># also meets the crtieria for being &quot;zero-rated&quot; (RED Implemementing Regulation 2018/2066 Article 23c (c)).</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># The &quot;zero-rated&quot; does not apply to methane and nitrous oxide which for bio and electro are all defined</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># as TBM (to be measured) and for blue either TBM or N/A (not applicable). In this case they should use the</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># &quot;highest in class&quot; value which for all fuels correspond to methane emissions of 0.00005 and nitrous oxide</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># emissions of 0.00018.</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># LSFO</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_ttw<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;carbon_dioxide&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Variable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_default_diesel_carbon_dioxide&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_ttw<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;methane&quot;</span>, &lt;<span class=\"kt\">Variable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_default_diesel_ice_methane&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span> * <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_ets_ghg_phase_in&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>&gt;<span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_ttw<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;nitrous_oxide&quot;</span>, &lt;<span class=\"kt\">Variable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_default_diesel_ice_nitrous_oxide&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span> * <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_ets_ghg_phase_in&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>&gt;<span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># e-ammonia</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_ttw<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_electro&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;carbon_dioxide&quot;</span>, <span class=\"m\">0</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_ttw<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_electro&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;methane&quot;</span>, &lt;<span class=\"kt\">Variable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_default_diesel_ice_methane&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span> * <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_ets_ghg_phase_in&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>&gt;<span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_ttw<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_electro&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;nitrous_oxide&quot;</span>, &lt;<span class=\"kt\">Variable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_default_diesel_ice_nitrous_oxide&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span> * <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_ets_ghg_phase_in&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>&gt;<span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "</pre><div class=\"cap\">includes/fuel_eu.inc</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ---------------------------------- FUEL EU --------------------------------------------- </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># This block represents the FuelEU Maritime regulation, which limits GHG intensity of fuels </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># used in EU waters. It applies fully to the ships in the Baltics.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># The policy promotes low-emission fuels like bio-methanol and penalizes fossil fuels, </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># helping simulate regulatory impact on fuel choice and compliance costs.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Regulation</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;fuel_eu&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\n",
       "\tMeasure <span class=\"o\">=</span> INTENSITY\n",
       "\tScheme <span class=\"o\">=</span> FLEXIBLE\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\tScope <span class=\"o\">=</span> WTW\n",
       "\tIncludeSlip <span class=\"o\">=</span> FALSE <span class=\"c\"># accounted for through TTW methane emission factors</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "\tEmissions <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"kt\">Emission</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;carbon_dioxide&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Emission</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;methane&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Emission</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;nitrous_oxide&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)]</span>\n",
       "\tFuels <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Fuel</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\tIntraFraction <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">1</span>\n",
       "\tInterFraction <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">0.5</span>\n",
       "\tExtraFraction <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\tJurisdiction <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;helsinki&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;stockholm&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;gdansk&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;tallinn&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)]</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\tRemedialCost <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Variable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fuel_eu_remedial_cost&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\tSharedThreshold <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fuel_eu_target_reduction&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># FuelEU applies to both domestic and international vessels that enter or operate in the EU</span>\n",
       "\tset_include_vessel<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span>, TRUE<span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># Global warming potentials</span>\n",
       "\tset_global_warming_potential<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;carbon_dioxide&quot;</span>, <span class=\"m\">1</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\tset_global_warming_potential<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;methane&quot;</span>, <span class=\"m\">25</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\tset_global_warming_potential<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;nitrous_oxide&quot;</span>, <span class=\"m\">298</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># LSFO</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_wtt<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span>, <span class=\"m\">0</span><span class=\"o\">)</span> <span class=\"c\"># this overwrites the Navigate calculation of WTT</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_wtt<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;carbon_dioxide&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Variable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fuel_eu_default_wtt_fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_ttw<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;carbon_dioxide&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Variable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_default_diesel_carbon_dioxide&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_ttw<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;methane&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Variable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_default_diesel_ice_methane&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_ttw<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;fossil_fuel_oil&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;nitrous_oxide&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Variable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_default_diesel_ice_nitrous_oxide&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># e-ammonia</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># since e-fuels require certified actual values under FuelEU and has no WTT defaults, we use the dynamically calculated Navigate values</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_ttw<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_electro&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;carbon_dioxide&quot;</span>, <span class=\"m\">0</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_ttw<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_electro&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;methane&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Variable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_default_diesel_ice_methane&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "\tset_fuel_ttw<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;ammonia_electro&quot;</span>, <span class=\"s\">&quot;nitrous_oxide&quot;</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Variable</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;eu_default_diesel_ice_nitrous_oxide&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">))</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "</pre><div class=\"cap\">includes/net_zero_framework.inc</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># -------------------------- NET ZERO FRAMEWORK REGULATIONS --------------------------</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Implements an interpretation of the IMO Net Zero Framework (January 2026).</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Defines a well-to-wake (WTW) emissions intensity pathway aligned with net-zero goals.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Applies across fuels and vessel types, with adjustable scope, jurisdiction, and coverage.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Regulation</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;net_zero_framework&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\tMeasure <span class=\"o\">=</span> INTENSITY\n",
       "\tScheme <span class=\"o\">=</span> FLEXIBLE\n",
       "\n",
       "\tScope <span class=\"o\">=</span> WTW\n",
       "\tIncludeSlip <span class=\"o\">=</span> TRUE\n",
       "\n",
       "\tEmissions <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Emission</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\tFuels <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Fuel</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t\t\n",
       "\tJurisdiction <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span><span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;helsinki&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;stockholm&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;gdansk&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>, <span class=\"kt\">Port</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;tallinn&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)]</span>\n",
       "\t \n",
       "\tRemedialCost <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;net_zero_framework_remedial&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\tSharedThreshold <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span><span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;net_zero_framework_z_values&quot;</span><span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\tset_include_vessel<span class=\"o\">(</span><span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span>, TRUE<span class=\"o\">)</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;net_zero_framework_z_values&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\t<span class=\"kt\">Table</span> <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2025&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">1.00</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;31-12-2027&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">1.00</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2028&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.96</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2029&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.94</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2030&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.92</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2031&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.876</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2032&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.832</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2033&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.788</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2034&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.744</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2035&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.70</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2040&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.35</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2050&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0.05</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\tMultiplier <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">93.3</span>\n",
       "\tExtrapolate <span class=\"o\">=</span> FLAT\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># Here you can change the remedial cost</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Forecast</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;net_zero_framework_remedial&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\t<span class=\"kt\">Table</span> <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"o\">[</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2025&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;31-12-2027&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">0</span>\n",
       "\t\t<span class=\"s\">&quot;01-01-2028&quot;</span>\t<span class=\"m\">1000</span>\n",
       "\t<span class=\"o\">]</span>\n",
       "\t\n",
       "\tExtrapolate <span class=\"o\">=</span> FLAT\n",
       "}\n",
       "</pre></div><div class=\"p5\"><div class=\"cap\">includes/decision_processes.inc</div><pre><span class=\"c\"># SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># --------------------------- DECISION PROCESSES ----------------------------------</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># This file defines how quickly the fleet and producers can adopt new fuels or technologies</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># over time. These settings act as behavioral levers, influencing the model’s flexibility </span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># in switching between fuels or retrofitting ships.</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\">#</span>\n",
       "<span class=\"c\"># -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Fleet</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;*&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># Decision sensitivities for newbuilds (odds ratios)</span>\n",
       "\tInterFuelSensitivity <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">0.5</span> <span class=\"c\"># Between fuel types: a 10% higher LCOT halves the odds</span>\n",
       "\tIntraFuelSensitivity <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">0.5</span> <span class=\"c\"># Within a single fuel type</span>\n",
       "\tTechnologySensitivity <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">2</span>  <span class=\"c\"># Energy efficiency: a 5%-of-CAPEX NPV advantage doubles the odds</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "<span class=\"kt\">Producer</span> <span class=\"s\">&quot;epc_europe&quot;</span> {\n",
       "\t<span class=\"c\"># Decision sensitivities for split between plants</span>\n",
       "    FuelDemandSensitivity <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">1.25</span> <span class=\"c\"># Between fuel pathways: a 10% higher expected demand gives 1.25x the odds</span>\n",
       "    FuelCostSensitivity <span class=\"o\">=</span> <span class=\"m\">0.5</span>    <span class=\"c\"># Within a pathway: a 10% higher LCoF halves the odds</span>\n",
       "}\n",
       "</pre></div></div>"
      ],
      "text/plain": [
       "# ---- example_3.nav ----\n",
       "# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping\n",
       "# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0\n",
       "\n",
       "# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
       "# SETTING THE SCENE – EXAMPLE 3 (BALTIC PRODUCT TANKERS WITH E-AMMONIA AND\n",
       "# ENERGY EFFICIENCIES)\n",
       "#\n",
       "# This example is based in Helsinki and is modeled through two operators with\n",
       "# similar fleets. Each operates a mix of MR tankers (~47k DWT) and coastal\n",
       "# tankers (~7.5k DWT) trading across the Baltic Sea, with regular voyages linking\n",
       "# Helsinki, Stockholm, Tallinn, and Gdansk.\n",
       "#\n",
       "# Both operators can use conventional fossil fuel or transition to\n",
       "# e-ammonia as an alternative. Fuel availability is assumed to be uneven:\n",
       "# Helsinki and Stockholm provide both fossil fuels and e-ammonia, while Tallinn\n",
       "# and Gdansk supply fossil fuels only.\n",
       "#\n",
       "# The distinction lies in their adoption of energy-efficiency (EE) measures. One\n",
       "# operator (EE_fleet) implements a package of EE measures (such as hull and\n",
       "# propeller improvements, weather routing, and alternative power devices), while\n",
       "# the other (regular_fleet) does not. This setup allows for a direct comparison\n",
       "# of the economic and emissions impact of efficiency retrofits, under otherwise\n",
       "# identical conditions.\n",
       "#\n",
       "# Operating within the European regulatory zone, the fleets are subject to both\n",
       "# IMO measures (CII and potential NZF) and EU regulations (FuelEU\n",
       "# Maritime and the EU ETS). These frameworks create strong incentives for\n",
       "# reducing emissions through both fuel switching and efficiency improvements.\n",
       "#\n",
       "# This scenario provides a reference case for analyzing the combined and\n",
       "# comparative impacts of e-ammonia adoption and energy-efficiency measures on\n",
       "# short-sea tanker economics in the Baltic. Users can adjust fleet composition,\n",
       "# efficiency uptake, fuel costs, and regulatory assumptions in the .inc files to\n",
       "# test sensitivities and policy outcomes.\n",
       "#\n",
       "# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
       "\n",
       "DEFINE {\n",
       "\n",
       "    # -------------------------- DEFINITIONS --------------------------\n",
       "    # Import the default model settings. These provide baseline constants\n",
       "    # and parameters that can be overwritten in this scenario.\n",
       "    Load DefaultModelDefinition\n",
       "\n",
       "    # ---------------------------- FLEET ------------------------------\n",
       "    # Defines the fleets of the two different operators, contaning multiple\n",
       "    # tankers and similar vessel types, but differentiation on the EE-measures.\n",
       "    Include \"includes/regular_fleet_curves.inc\"\n",
       "    Include \"includes/regular_fleet.inc\"\n",
       "    Include \"includes/efficient_fleet_curves.inc\"\n",
       "    Include \"includes/efficient_fleet.inc\"\n",
       "\n",
       "    # ----------------------------- ROUTE -----------------------------\n",
       "    # Defines the ports included in the scenario (Helsinki, Stockholm, Tallinn, \n",
       "    # Gdansk) along with their characteristics. The route file specifies the \n",
       "    # distribution of voyages, port calls, and time allocation between sea \n",
       "    # and port conditions.\n",
       "    Include \"includes/route.inc\"\n",
       "    Include \"includes/ports.inc\"\n",
       "    Include \"includes/bunker_logistics.inc\"\n",
       "\n",
       "    # ----------------------------- FUEL ------------------------------\n",
       "    # Defines the fuels available in the scenario, their production processes,\n",
       "    # feedstocks, costs, and emission factors. Regional differences and\n",
       "    # plants are also defined here. \n",
       "    Include \"includes/fuel_production.inc\"\n",
       "    Include \"includes/regions.inc\"\n",
       "    Include \"includes/producer.inc\"\n",
       "    Load DefaultEmission\n",
       "\n",
       "    # -------------------------- REGULATION ---------------------------\n",
       "    # Defines the relevant international regulatory frameworks affecting the\n",
       "    # fleet. As we operate within EU, both IMO and EU jurisdiction are in \n",
       "    # effect. \n",
       "    Include \"includes/cii.inc\"\n",
       "    Include \"includes/eu_ets.inc\"\n",
       "    Include \"includes/fuel_eu.inc\"\n",
       "    Include \"includes/net_zero_framework.inc\"\n",
       "\n",
       "    # ---------------- DECISION PROCESESS ---------------------------\n",
       "    Include \"includes/decision_processes.inc\"\n",
       "\n",
       "    # -------------------------- OUTPUT -----------------------------\n",
       "    Load DefaultPlot\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "EVENTS {\n",
       "    # time-steps\n",
       "\tLoad DefaultTimeStepYearly\n",
       "}\n",
       "# ---- includes/regular_fleet.inc ----\n",
       "# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping\n",
       "# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0\n",
       "\n",
       "# ------------------------------ REGULAR FLEET --------------------------------\n",
       "#\n",
       "# This file defines the baseline Baltic tanker fleet without any additional\n",
       "# energy-efficiency measures. The fleet includes both coastal tankers (~7,500\n",
       "# DWT) and MR tankers (~47,000 DWT), operating between Helsinki, Stockholm,\n",
       "# Tallinn, and Gdansk. \n",
       "#\n",
       "# Vessels can be modeled on conventional fossil fuels or on e-ammonia,\n",
       "# allowing direct comparison of fuel transition costs and emissions. In this\n",
       "# baseline version, no efficiency upgrades are applied, providing a reference\n",
       "# case against which the EE fleet can be compared.\n",
       "#\n",
       "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
       "\n",
       "Copy Vessel \"tanker_47k_dwt_ice_oil\"        \"mid_range_regular_oil\"\n",
       "Copy Vessel \"tanker_47k_dwt_ice_ammonia\"    \"mid_range_regular_ammonia\"\n",
       "\n",
       "Copy Vessel \"tanker_7500_dwt_ice_oil\"        \"coastal_regular_oil\"\n",
       "Copy Vessel \"tanker_7500_dwt_ice_ammonia\"    \"coastal_regular_ammonia\"\n",
       "\n",
       "Fleet \"mid_range_regular\" {\n",
       "\tVessels = [Vessel(\"mid_range_regular_oil\"), Vessel(\"mid_range_regular_ammonia\")]\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialVessels = 2\n",
       "\tInitialSplit = [0.5, 0.5]\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialAgeDistribution = [\n",
       "\t\tCurve(\"age_dist_mid_range_regular_oil\"),\n",
       "\t\tCurve(\"age_dist_mid_range_regular_ammonia\")\n",
       "\t]\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "\t# Trade growth: annual growth rate of 5%, but can be changed if expected otherwise or disabled to keep constant. \n",
       "\tTradeGrowth = 0.05\n",
       "\n",
       "\t# disallow the approximation of technology uptake from other fleets\n",
       "\tAllowTechnologyApproximation = FALSE\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "Fleet \"coastal_regular\" {\n",
       "\tVessels = [Vessel(\"coastal_regular_oil\"), Vessel(\"coastal_regular_ammonia\")]\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialVessels = 3\n",
       "\tInitialSplit = [1.0, 0.0]\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialAgeDistribution = [\n",
       "\t\tCurve(\"age_dist_coastal_regular_oil\"),\n",
       "\t\t0\n",
       "\t]\n",
       "\n",
       "\t# Trade growth: annual growth rate of 5%, but can be changed if expected otherwise or disabled to keep constant.\n",
       "\tTradeGrowth = 0.05\n",
       "\n",
       "\t# disallow the approximation of technology uptake from other fleets\n",
       "\tAllowTechnologyApproximation = FALSE\n",
       "}\n",
       "# ---- includes/efficient_fleet.inc ----\n",
       "# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping\n",
       "# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0\n",
       "\n",
       "# ------------------------------- EE FLEET ------------------------------------\n",
       "#\n",
       "# This file defines the Baltic tanker fleet with energy-efficiency measures\n",
       "# enabled. As with the regular fleet, it includes both coastal tankers (~7,500\n",
       "# DWT) and MR tankers (~47,000 DWT), trading between Helsinki, Stockholm,\n",
       "# Tallinn, and Gdansk.\n",
       "#\n",
       "# Vessels can operate on fossil fuels or adopt e-ammonia, and have\n",
       "# similar specifications to those in the regular fleet. \n",
       "#\n",
       "# This efficient fleet, however, get energy efficiency measures enabled from the\n",
       "# .inc file \"energy_efficiencies\".\n",
       "#\n",
       "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
       "\n",
       "Copy Vessel \"tanker_47k_dwt_ice_oil\"        \"mid_range_efficient_oil\"\n",
       "Copy Vessel \"tanker_47k_dwt_ice_ammonia\"    \"mid_range_efficient_ammonia\"\n",
       "\n",
       "Copy Vessel \"tanker_7500_dwt_ice_oil\"        \"coastal_efficient_oil\"\n",
       "Copy Vessel \"tanker_7500_dwt_ice_ammonia\"    \"coastal_efficient_ammonia\"\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "Fleet \"mid_range_efficient\" {\n",
       "\tVessels = [Vessel(\"mid_range_efficient_oil\"), Vessel(\"mid_range_efficient_ammonia\")]\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialVessels = 2\n",
       "\tInitialSplit = [0.5, 0.5]\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialAgeDistribution = [\n",
       "\t\tCurve(\"age_dist_mid_range_efficient_oil\"),\n",
       "\t\tCurve(\"age_dist_mid_range_efficient_ammonia\")\n",
       "\t]\n",
       "\n",
       "\n",
       "\t# Trade growth: annual growth rate of 5%, but can be changed if expected otherwise or disabled to keep constant. \n",
       "\tTradeGrowth = 0.05\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "Fleet \"coastal_efficient\" {\n",
       "\tVessels = [Vessel(\"coastal_efficient_oil\"), Vessel(\"coastal_efficient_ammonia\")]\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialVessels = 3\n",
       "\tInitialSplit = [1.0, 0.0]\n",
       "\n",
       "\tInitialAgeDistribution = [\n",
       "\t\tCurve(\"age_dist_coastal_efficient_oil\"),\n",
       "\t\t0\n",
       "\t]\n",
       "\n",
       "\t# Trade growth: annual growth rate of 5%, but can be changed if expected otherwise or disabled to keep constant.\n",
       "\tTradeGrowth = 0.05\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",
       "Fleet \"*_efficient\" {\n",
       "\tTechnologies = [\n",
       "\t\tTechnology(\"air_lubrication_tanker_35k_dwt\"),\n",
       "\t\tTechnology(\"cargo_systems_tanker_35k_dwt\"),\n",
       "\t\tTechnology(\"exhaust_gas_boiler_ae_tanker_35k_dwt\"),\n",
       "\t\tTechnology(\"flettner_rotor_tanker_35k_dwt\"),\n",
       "\t\tTechnology(\"hull_painting_tanker_35k_dwt\"),\n",
       "\t\tTechnology(\"lighting_system_tanker_35k_dwt\"),\n",
       "\t\tTechnology(\"propeller_improvement_devices_tanker_35k_dwt\"),\n",
       "\t\tTechnology(\"variable_frequency_drive_tanker_35k_dwt\")\n",
       "\t]\n",
       "}\n",
       "\n",

       "# ---- includes/efficient_fleet_curves.inc ----\n",
       "# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fonden Mærsk Mc-Kinney Møller Center for Zero Carbon Shipping\n",
